references.retrieval: Direct full article; Methods/Multivariate anthropometric accommodation and Results/Multivariate anthropometric models reviewed.
references.cohort: Historical US truck drivers; not an athlete or NFL cohort.
references.methodObservation: Twelve linked dimensions reduced to three principal components; male explained variation 88%. Male inputs log-transformed after normality checks; one outlier removed. Fifteen boundary/center models describe accommodation, not population prevalence.
references.sourceConflict: Rendered Table 1 grand total says 1995; sex totals, abstract and Table 2 support 1950. Preserve this conflict; never adopt the grand-total cell silently.
references.limitation: No coefficients, participant values or frequencies transferred into football generation. Accommodation boundary models are not a random player generator.

references.retrieval: Direct official release reviewed; raw records and measurement handbook remain unreviewed.
references.observations: Official public release describes 93 body measures from 4082 men and 1986 women, separately from surface scans.
references.archiveDisposition: Not downloaded. Package-trust output 0e55e8: BLOCK; checksum/signature and official-source verification required.
references.limitation: Historical soldier sample supplies neither world demographics nor NFL body-shape frequencies. No raw-record covariance or endpoint map verified.

implementationInferences.jointFitting: Select a reproducible conditional multivariate model or compatible nearest-neighbor residual model after comparing held-out athlete reconstruction. Retain source units, landmarks, posture and measurement error before normalizing.
implementationInferences.conditioning: Condition on compatible stature, dated mass and recorded measurements; retain residual covariance among missing breadths, depths, segment lengths and girths. Race, hair, skin and eyes are not performance or physique inputs.
implementationInferences.modelSelection: Compare reconstruction error and conditional covariance, not only marginal means. Validate heavy/tall/short and position strata; disclose effective sample size, unsupported cells and extrapolation. A reference model cannot silently narrow measured athlete tails.
implementationInferences.tails: Save observations outside fitted reference coverage unchanged. Separate a source outlier flag from measurement error or geometry conflict; only conflicting evidence triggers a disclosed residual/refusal. Never discard a valid heavy-fast player solely for being statistically rare.
implementationInferences.sampling: Sample a supported joint interior distribution with saved individual residuals. Boundary representatives are deterministic stress cases, never equally likely player templates. No universal normality assumption or imported truck-driver coefficients.
implementationInferences.rendering: Resolve the same saved shape in front, side and motion. Preserve bones and measurement endpoints; reallocate compatible soft-tissue bulk through dated physical changes. Artistic density/surface assumptions retain separate provenance.
